📋 TEST SCENARIO
Verify end-to-end flight locking and unlocking (First Lock -> Then Unlock) in Flights List View (Ongoing Section).
============== INTRODUCTION ================ Test Scenario: Verify end-to-end flight locking and unlocking (First Lock -> Then Unlock) in Flights List View (Ongoing Section). Steps: 1. Authenticate / Login to application (managed via @pytest.mark.login). 2. Navigate to Flights List View. 3. Ensure Ongoing Section is active (do not navigate to any other section). 4. Locate the target flight card on the dashboard and ensure it is in an unlocked state (reset if initially locked). 5. Lock the flight by clicking Three-Dots menu ('more_vert') -> 'Lock Flight', filling Reason ('Test') and Remarks ('Testing Flight'), and clicking Lock. 6. Verify and assert that the flight is now in LOCKED state (lock icon button is displayed). 7. Unlock the flight by clicking the lock icon button on the flight card, entering Remarks ('Testing Unlock'), and clicking Unlock. 8. Verify and assert that the flight is now in UNLOCKED state (lock icon button is absent).
